migration_objective: Use ML-DSA-65 verification and preserve rejection of tampered grants and wrong keys.
preconditions: Products and installation identifiers are synthetic.
expected_behavior: Only authentic licenses matching product, installation, requested feature, and current time validate.
Revoked IDs in the offline snapshot invalidate licenses.
Expiry and issue boundaries are enforced consistently.
migration_requirements: Use ML-DSA-65 with a LicenseDesk-specific signature context.
Replace RSA public-key serialization and update all consumers without fallback.
Preserve offline verification and revocation snapshot formats and semantics.
verification_procedure: Run baseline and PQC test modules independently.
Verify issuance, valid and invalid installation/product/feature claims, expiry, revocation, malformed grants, and key serialization.
known_limitations: Synthetic software licensing only; no commercial licensing or tamper-resistant client enforcement.
